summary: Diff implements substantial admin UI (AdminShell theme, admin pages for categories/breeds/videos, RequireAdmin Access Denied screen, navbar Admin link gating, image uploader, and admin video hooks). However, the diff summary does not show any route registration for /admin and its subroutes, nor does it provide evidence of the required backend admin bootstrap mechanism and enforceable admin-only authorization for CRUD endpoints.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin Dashboard reachable at /admin with sub-routes /admin/categories, /admin/breeds, /admin/videos; direct visits by non-admin show an Access Denied screen.
missing_requirements.reason: While RequireAdmin provides an Access Denied screen and Navbar conditionally shows an Admin link, the diff summary does not include any router configuration/route files proving that /admin and its subroutes are actually registered and wrapped with RequireAdmin.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes working isCallerAdmin used by frontend, has a secure documented bootstrap mechanism for first admin on fresh deploy, and enforces admin-only authorization for category/breed/video CRUD.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo changes show inclusion of an authorization mixin/state, but the diff summary is truncated and does not show (a) an isCallerAdmin method, (b) a documented bootstrap mechanism, or (c) explicit authorization checks/traps on the admin CRUD methods for categories/breeds/videos.

missing_requirements.requirement: Complete Admin Dashboard CRUD for categories, breeds, and video links with list refresh after mutations, including image upload using existing blob storage integration.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend admin pages and video hooks are present, but the diff summary does not show the corresponding backend CRUD endpoints for categories/breeds/videos or their admin-only authorization enforcement. Also, list refresh after category/breed mutations depends on hooks in useContentManagement, which are not included in the diff summary so cannot be verified.

hallucinated_features.description: Large static breed catalog expansion including 30+ bird breeds (in addition to cats/dogs).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest (scope was admin dashboard routes/access control/CRUD for categories, breeds, and video links).

hallucinated_features.description: AI Assistant page includes an optional developer test harness accessible via query parameter for testing breed identification accuracy.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; BuildRequest explicitly scoped to admin dashboard functionality and non-goals did not include adding dev harnesses.

hallucinated_features.description: New/expanded emergency triage and behavioral assessment rule engines and multi-step flows.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested as part of building the admin dashboard panel.
